articles.summary: A lender sends adverse action notices automatically by connecting its credit decision system to a notice workflow. That workflow triggers on a decline or counteroffer, fills a compliant template with the specific principal reasons, then delivers and logs the notice. An adverse action notice is a required message that tells an applicant credit was denied, or offered on worse terms, and why.
articles.title: How to Send Adverse Action Notices Automatically: A Lender's Guide
